subject.title: [Bug]: qqbot + ollama + local model: qwen3.5:27b report: error Embedded agent failed before reply: LLM request failed: network connection was interrupted

question: For QQBot local Ollama runs that stay silent or hit transport resets before a configured 1800s provider timeout, should OpenClaw keep surfacing/recovering early provider transport failures or wait longer in the QQBot/diagnostic path?
rationale: The old QQBot 300s watchdog is fixed, but changing the remaining timeout/recovery behavior is a product tradeoff between quicker recovery from broken transports and honoring very slow local-provider expectations.

options.title: Keep Open For Live Repro
options.body: Require redacted current-main QQBot, OpenClaw, and Ollama logs before choosing a code change.

options.title: Define Longer Local Wait Policy
options.body: Sponsor a change that makes diagnostics or recovery honor configured local-provider silence longer, with tests for wedged-session behavior.

options.title: Document Transport Reset As Provider Failure
options.body: Treat ECONNRESET before the timeout as an Ollama/server/network problem unless new evidence shows OpenClaw aborts the request.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Live Repro
recommendation.body: Require redacted current-main QQBot, OpenClaw, and Ollama logs before choosing a code change.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior QQBot/Ollama watchdog replacement PR and automerge request tie this area to the earlier maintainer decision path.
